hero.title: About the foundation
hero.intro: The Dogecoin Foundation is a not-for-profit organisation established to provide:
bulletPoints: Support for the Dogecoin crypto-currency through development and advocacy.
Dogecoin trademark defense to prevent abuse and fraud.
A trailmap for the future of Dogecoin.

manifesto.title: The Dogecoin Manifesto
manifesto.intro:
We are Dogecoin, the accidental crypto-movement that makes people smile.
[space]
[small]We are developing a currency for the people,[/small]
[small]and we strive to do only good everyday.[/small]
[small]Through this work we have come to value:[/small]
[space]
[gray]Being[/gray] [bold]useful[/bold][gray], we value[/gray] utility [gray]over[/gray] technical brilliance.
[gray]Being[/gray] [bold]personable[/bold][gray], we value[/gray] individuals and interactions [gray]over[/gray] profit-driven economics.
[gray]Being[/gray] [bold]welcoming[/bold][gray], we value[/gray] collaboration and trust [gray]over[/gray] competition and exclusivity.
[gray]Being[/gray] [bold]reliable[/bold][gray], we value[/gray] working solutions [gray]over[/gray] speed of delivery.
[space]
[small]That is, while there is value in the items on the right,[/small]
[small]we value the items on the left more.[/small]

history.title: Our history
history.description: The Foundation was established by Dogecoin team members in 2014 to support and advocate for the project. Created in December 2013 by Billy Markus and Jackson Palmer as a fun alternative to Bitcoin, Dogecoin was inspired by the "Doge" meme and quickly gained a strong community known for charitable efforts, such as funding the Jamaican bobsled team and Doge4Water.
history.description2: As interest fluctuated, the Foundation became less active but was revived in 2021 by original team members, new faces, and advisors like Ethereum's Vitalik Buterin and Neuralink's Jared Birchall. The revival aimed to secure funding, provide strategic direction, and ensure Dogecoin's long-term growth.

mission.title: Such Mission
mission.description: Our mission is to promote the development and adoption of Dogecoin as a fun, accessible, and inclusive cryptocurrency.

cards.title: Community

cards.title: Innovation
cards.description: Drive innovation in blockchain technology while maintaining simplicity and usability.

cards.title: Education
cards.description: Provide educational resources to help people understand and safely use cryptocurrency.

cards.title: Charity
cards.description: Support charitable causes and community initiatives that make the world a better place.

cards.title: Transparency
cards.description: Maintain transparency in all our operations and decision-making processes.

cards.title: Sustainability
cards.description: Ensure the long-term sustainability and growth of the Dogecoin ecosystem.

cards.title: Fun
cards.description: Keep the fun and lighthearted spirit that makes Dogecoin unique and enjoyable.
